{{Quote|Bak! It's a&hellip; Blast him, moron! The frammin' Crotok's got a&hellip;|Druug's last words before the ''Profit'' was destroyed|<ref name="ABGTAS" />}}
'''''Profit''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] which was owned by the [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual named [[Druug]] and used as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] vessel during an [[Ambush near Darknon Station|ambush]] near the [[Space station/Legends|Space station]], [[Darknon Station]]. The ship worked together with two other pirate vessels, one named ''[[Trust Me]]'' and the other called ''[[Pillage]]'', piloted by a male named [[Larken]]. The three vessels lay in wait undercover of a [[Ion storm/Legends|magnetic storm]] for their target, a [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] named ''[[Kizbon's Box]]'', whose location they knew due to a tip from a female named [[Sahr]]. When the target arrived the ''Trust Me'' sent a binary pulse to signal the others and the ships moved to attack the supposedly unarmed interceptor, only to discover that it was armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] which it used to destroy the ''Trust Me'' immediately. Upon seeing the other ships destruction Druug began cursing over the [[Comlink/Legends|comm]] before the interceptor opened fire on ''Profit'' and destroyed it as well, leaving behind a burning hull.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Profit'' first appeared in [[1995]] the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. The ship appeared in one of these, titled "''Kizbon's Box''" which gave no information as to what era it was set in.
